package.name: eigen_vendor
package.description: Builds Eigen 3.4.0 (header-only linear algebra) cross-compiled for VxWorks and installs its cmake config, so consumers (orocos_kdl_vendor, tf2_eigen, ...) resolve find_package(Eigen3) / eigen3_cmake_module. Matches the harness pkg/eigen 3PP and Ubuntu 26.04 libeigen3-dev (3.4.0).
